in_sanskrit.name: Dippu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lamp, Light
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dippu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning a lamp or light. This name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.

in_hindi.name: Dippu
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lamp, Light
in_hindi.long_meaning: Dippu एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning a lamp or light. This name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.

in_tamil.name: Dippu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lamp, Light
in_tamil.long_meaning: Dippu ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning a lamp or light. This name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.

in_telugu.name: Dippu
in_telugu.long_meaning: Dippu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning a lamp or light. This name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.

in_marathi.name: Dippu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dippu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning a lamp or light. This name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.

in_bengali.name: Dippu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lamp, Light
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dippu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning a lamp or light. This name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.
